title: From trainee property agent to agency owner, the career ladder explained with Ledger in 90 seconds
summary: Viewers see agents on every street corner; the ladder shows the licence step and the move from selling to running an agency.

beats.label: title
beats.voice: From trainee property agent to agency owner, the career ladder explained with Ledger in ninety seconds.
onScreen: From trainee property agent to agency owner, the career ladder explained with Ledger
beats.visual: Title scene: full-bleed room, a ladder on the right, the five steps below, small Ledger in the re_trainee outfit waving on the bottom step; a dashed arrow climbs to the top; the title card and the 90-second pill appear on the title words

beats.label: rung 1 THE TRAINEE
beats.voice: First, Ledger is the trainee agent, with a folder of listings.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (re_trainee: white shirt with a lanyard, blue agency tie, folder of listings, backpack). Header THE TRAINEE. Ledger alone, scale 3.2; arrows pop in on 'folder' and 'lanyard'

beats.label: rung 1 THE TRAINEE
beats.voice: Then he books viewings, and shows clients around the homes.
beats.visual: A calendar books slots; Ledger opens a door for two clients

beats.label: rung 1 THE TRAINEE
beats.voice: He passes each offer to his agent, who talks to the seller.
beats.visual: An offer sheet moves from Ledger to a licensed agent figure

beats.label: rung 1 THE TRAINEE
beats.voice: So on this rung, he shows homes under a licensed agent.
beats.visual: Slider at 0.06 on 'Shows'

beats.label: climb 1 to 2
beats.voice: After that, he climbs to sales agent.
beats.visual: Ledger climbs the ladder from rung 1 to rung 2; his outfit swaps mid-climb to the next set; the next rung tag lights up on the naming word

beats.label: rung 2 SALES AGENT
beats.voice: Now he is a licensed sales agent, and works for a broker.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (re_agent: navy blazer, agency pin, phone in hand, no backpack). Header SALES AGENT. A licence card appears beside Ledger and a broker figure stands behind

beats.label: rung 2 SALES AGENT
beats.voice: Then he promotes listings, and presents offers.
beats.visual: A listing poster goes up; Ledger shows an offer paper to a seller

beats.label: rung 2 SALES AGENT
beats.voice: And he negotiates, until both sides agree.
beats.visual: Two figures, a price arrow moves between them until a handshake

beats.label: climb 2 to 3
beats.voice: Then he climbs again, to senior agent.
beats.visual: Ledger climbs the ladder from rung 2 to rung 3; his outfit swaps mid-climb to the next set; the next rung tag lights up on the naming word

beats.label: rung 3 SENIOR AGENT
beats.voice: As senior agent, he mentors new agents.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (re_senior: grey suit, red pocket square, car key, glasses). Header SENIOR AGENT. A trainee follows Ledger through a viewing

beats.label: rung 3 SENIOR AGENT
beats.voice: He also works with the solicitor, and the surveyor.
beats.visual: Two figures, a solicitor and a surveyor, each pass a document to Ledger

beats.label: rung 3 SENIOR AGENT
beats.voice: So he shows a little less, and starts to lead.
beats.visual: Slider at 0.35

beats.label: climb 3 to 4
beats.voice: Next, he steps up as associate broker.
beats.visual: Ledger climbs the ladder from rung 3 to rung 4; his outfit swaps mid-climb to the next set; the next rung tag lights up on the naming word

beats.label: rung 4 ASSOCIATE BROKER
beats.voice: Now he holds a broker licence, and manages an office.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (re_broker: charcoal suit, broker licence badge, tablet, glasses). Header ASSOCIATE BROKER. A licence is upgraded to a broker licence; an office with three desks

beats.label: rung 4 ASSOCIATE BROKER
beats.voice: Then he hires and trains agents, and reviews their deals.
beats.visual: A new agent figure joins; Ledger ticks each deal on a clipboard

beats.label: climb 4 to 5
beats.voice: Finally, he reaches the top rung, as agency owner.
beats.visual: Ledger climbs the ladder from rung 4 to rung 5; his outfit swaps mid-climb to the next set; the next rung tag lights up on the naming word

beats.label: rung 5 AGENCY OWNER
beats.voice: Finally, he opens his own agency, and runs the whole business.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (re_owner: black suit, gold pocket square, glasses, grey temples, a sign key). Header AGENCY OWNER. An agency sign goes up over a shopfront, Ledger cuts a ribbon

beats.label: rung 5 AGENCY OWNER
beats.voice: He sets the fees, and oversees the work of every agent.
beats.visual: A fee sheet; a row of agent desks with Ledger above

beats.label: rung 5 AGENCY OWNER
beats.voice: Yet he shows almost no homes himself, and answers for every deal.
beats.visual: Slider at 0.95 on 'Leads'; every desk has a signed deal

beats.label: payoff
beats.voice: So with each rung, Ledger showed fewer homes, and led more agents.
beats.visual: Five Ledgers on the ladder, all five tags ticked, the slider runs from the bottom word to the top word

beats.voice: To climb your own career ladder, learn technical business concepts at Edlintics.

caption:
From trainee property agent to agency owner, the job changes on every rung

The trainee books viewings and shows homes, and the sales agent presents offers and negotiates. Then the associate broker manages an office and trains new agents. Finally, the owner runs the whole agency

So each rung up, you show fewer homes yourself and lead more agents. Walk up the ladder with Ledger and note which rung you are on

sources.claim: Brokers are licensed to run their own real estate businesses and oversee sales agents; sales agents must work with a broker; agents advance by getting a broker's licence (usually 2 years as a licensed agent in most states); brokers open their own company or manage an office as associate brokers, hiring and training agents
Estate agent duties (valuations, viewings, negotiation, work with surveyors and solicitors) and progression to senior negotiator, branch manager, or own agency

openQuestions: BLS describes the US licence route (agent, broker); the UK National Careers Service uses senior negotiator and branch manager. The script follows the BLS names (sales agent, associate broker) and the UK 'own agency'. A trainee rung is not in either source (it is the entry role before licensing); say if you prefer to start at 'sales agent' and drop the trainee.
Soft claim: 'handles the biggest sales' on rung 3 has no source; reword to 'handles more of the sales' if Hoang prefers.
Titles vary by employer and country; the caption says nothing about pay or years
